candidate_workaround: Split repository refs, clean-state, live-remote, and drive-capacity checks into separately bounded probes and preserve every result before composing the preflight receipt.
failure_signature: A combined three-lane preflight exceeded its wrapper budget before returning consolidated source, owner, and drive evidence.
recurrence_guard: Do not combine multiple slow Windows Git status and filesystem probes under one short wrapper; bound and capture each surface independently.
rollback: Give the timed-out aggregate probe zero state-verification credit and rerun only smaller read-only probes.
scope_boundary: Owner-local read-only startup verification only; no independent-reproduction, production, security-complete, or scientific credit.
title: Split slow multi-surface startup probes before composition
